title: For God so loved
lyrics: For God so loved, he gave his son for us, what a thought, what a gift!
God loved us before we knew him, before we loved him, God loved us.
I have nothing to give to you, but the life you gave to me.
My life and my love I give to you, for you gave your life first for me.
For Christ so loved, he gave his life for us, what a thought, what a gift!
Christ loved us, before we knew him, before we loved him, Christ loved us.
Lord oh Lord, because you love me, how can I keep my love from you?
You loved me before I knew you, before I loved you, Lord, you loved me.
